workflow.title: New & Modified Stationary Source Air Authorization
workflow.description: Connecticut regulatory, applicability, professional-tool, and filing resources for evaluating the authorization path for new or modified stationary emissions sources.

relationships.workflow_note: Use as the current CT DEEP gateway for stationary-source permitting, regulations, forms, assistance, and related authorization programs.
Consult the maintained Connecticut regulatory gateway when identifying provisions relevant to the proposed emissions unit or source change.
Consult the controlling Connecticut requirements for New Source Review applicability, applications, and permit review.
Use CT DEEP's explanations of NSR, alternative authorization mechanisms, Title V handoffs, and common permitting issues.
Access CT DEEP's permit-screening wizard, emissions tools, control-technology resources, regulatory links, and pre-application support.
Use the maintained gateway for current NSR forms, modification and revision applications, notification forms, instructions, and submission requirements.
